evals.prompt: We're onboarding a new customer to Ingext and need to set up the Azure side. Can you help me create the ingext-audit application in our Entra tenant so Fluency can import our Office 365 and Azure AD audit logs? I have Global Admin.
evals.expected_output: The skill should explain it cannot run against the tenant itself and must guide the admin. It offers the PowerShell (recommended) and manual portal paths, lists the 9 required application permissions across Microsoft Graph and Office 365 Management APIs, covers app creation + admin consent + client secret, and ends by collecting the three fields tenantId, clientId, clientSecret (also as a JSON block).
expectations: The skill clarifies that Claude cannot run this in the customer's tenant and guides the admin instead
Both the PowerShell script path and manual portal path are offered
All 9 application permissions are named across Microsoft Graph (6) and Office 365 Management APIs (3)
The workflow includes granting tenant-wide admin consent and creating a client secret
The final output is the three fields tenantId, clientId, clientSecret, presented as a JSON block
The skill does not attempt to start O365 subscriptions or configure the Fluency connector

evals.prompt: Register the Entra app for Ingext audit import using PowerShell. Walk me through it.
evals.expected_output: The skill should point the admin to assets/setup-ingext-audit.ps1, note the Microsoft.Graph module prerequisite and the interactive sign-in, explain the script is idempotent, and describe that it prints tenantId/clientId/clientSecret as JSON to hand to the install-application stage.
expectations: The skill references the bundled setup-ingext-audit.ps1 script
It notes the Microsoft.Graph module prerequisite and interactive admin sign-in
It explains the script resolves permission role IDs dynamically and is idempotent
It describes the JSON output with the three fields for the downstream install-application stage

evals.prompt: I don't want to run any scripts — just tell me exactly what to click in the Azure portal to make the Fluency ingext-audit app.
evals.expected_output: The skill should give the manual portal walkthrough: New registration (single-tenant, named ingext-audit), copy tenant + client IDs, add the 6 Microsoft Graph and 3 Office 365 Management APIs application permissions (the latter via 'APIs my organization uses'), grant admin consent, create a 24-month client secret and copy its Value once, then hand off the three fields.
expectations: The skill provides the manual Azure portal path only
It specifies single-tenant registration named ingext-audit
It instructs finding Office 365 Management APIs under 'APIs my organization uses'
It calls out granting admin consent and copying the client secret Value once
It collects tenantId, clientId, clientSecret at the end
